title: Festival sacrifices as rudiments
english: On [[sacrifices ordered for each feast >> Bible:Numbers 28–29]]: rudiments feel heavy while the end of the discipline is unknown.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC (Numbers).
After Homilia XXIII; feast sacrifices CLOSEOUT.

title: End and fruit of the discipline
english: When perfection has followed, it will delight us to have borne the rudiments’ trouble — so also in the holy writings.

title: Feasts fulfilled in Christ
english: The law’s feasts are fulfilled in Christ — Passover, Pentecost, Tabernacles. Glory to him forever. Amen.
